content: TrendSpider: strategy tester accepts point-and-click conditions OR natural-language descriptions; Variance Explorer runs up to 52 parameter variants in one pass (parameter-drift sensitivity). Explicit gaps per review: NO walk-forward optimization, NO Monte Carlo resampling, no portfolio-level or multi-symbol backtests, no tick-level sim; backtests single-symbol, capped 2k-30k candles by tier, 1-minute finest.
